merges.why: Both doc-only, same owner and files; docs ride together, one review.
One process-docs story from slices/06; three audit cycles for text-only changes is pure overhead.
Three small infra guards, no shared design; one capability: dev tooling cannot lose data or hide failures.
Builders exist to test the store; keys and store are one spec delta. Keep as tasks inside one change.
Codec, pack identity and id check are one save-envelope story with one migration spec.
Outcome, status and frame guard are one error-surfacing capability.
The seam is a task of the fixed step, not a separate capability.
Hash, golden run and lint are one 'determinism is enforced' capability.
Same module; fixes only make sense with the split.
Descriptor is consumed only by residency; one verifiable result.
Validation and its kind/ref tables are one spec.
Section docs truth is the docs half of the loader move; docs ride with the feature.
Feed, CLI and guards are one observable pipeline.
Rolls and stimulus eviction are part of the Act contract and should land as one frozen interface.
Notebook is the read side of the observation table; one spec delta.
Emergency runtime is mostly ledger consumption and has no fuse yet; same runtime store pattern.
Replay is the eval runner's input; one capability: npm run eval:ai replays a script.
Port, gate and history are one text-source story, still behind the authoring kit.
The lab is the only way to verify the grammar; ship as one.
A skeleton with no thread proves nothing; the milestone is 'one thread end to end'. Ledger/end card stays separate.

splits.why: Engine and authoring lab are different layers and review stories.
Untouched, unscoped blob; it is the definition of done and must be scoped before it can be reviewed.
Utility AI is a decision engine; rivals plus remote evidence is a content and propagation story.
Four capabilities in one; arrival hold and the readability test are a separately verifiable feel check.

milestones.name: M1 Trustworthy foundation
milestones.outcome: Docs say what is true, the gates exist, saves round-trip, and a golden seeded run hashes identically twice.

milestones.name: M2 Walkable, usable room
milestones.outcome: Walk a character around a room with footsteps, bump props, press Space to use things, open menus and change settings.

milestones.name: M3 Core model alive
milestones.outcome: Spend watch time, act, and see NPCs, beliefs and pressure shift in a headless run and in a crowd room, with telemetry visible.

milestones.name: M4 Talk and notebook
milestones.outcome: Hold a paged, menu-driven conversation with bubbles and lace page, then read what you learned in the notebook; eval:ai replays it.

milestones.name: M5 Vertical slice
milestones.outcome: Play one Epoch 1 thread from first clue to a stub end card; the go/no-go point for everything after.

milestones.name: M6 Breadth
milestones.outcome: Rivals, overview, generated text, advisors, audio lab, Delta/emergency, and crew handoff across epochs, ending in a finished Epoch 1.

risks: cm-act-envelope-and-rolls: every cm-*, 07, 09 and 06 change consumes the Act contract; a wrong envelope or roll model ripples through 30+ changes. Freeze it only after a throwaway spike with a second consumer (observation) wired in.
hx-fixed-step-tick (6a): tick phases and interpolation touch coordinator, renderer and every reducer ordering; bad phase order breaks determinism goldens and later presence/materialize.

cm-presence-and-materialize: bridges watches to rooms and the renderer; materialize-on-entry mistakes cause pop-in, double NPCs or desync, and 07/11 build on it. Also watch hx-save-integrity as the cheapest-to-get-wrong migration.
start_with: docs-spine-and-roadmap (merged docs-rules-spine plus roadmap-yaml): doc-only, zero code risk, and nearly every other change depends on it; then hx-ops-safety on the same day if time allows.
